outcome: A $0 review before launch found the search session's profile asset would land at artifacts/stages/stage-0/calibration_volume/profiles while every profile pins its items under profiles_pilot_v1 (setup copies an asset to <install_to>/<dest_name>); stage A would have refused on a billing pod. The fix edits launch.py, which moves the harness digest this one-use authorization binds, so the run is closed unlaunched and a fresh run id is issued. No provider resource was created.
